definitions.attempt_s: the gap from the last api-request before an answer to that answer
definitions.attempts: how many api-requests the round took: one attempt, plus retries
definitions.caller_wait_s: the gap from the FIRST api-request of the round to the answer: what the caller waited, retries included
definitions.client_patience_s: the gap from the last api-request of the round to the timeout that ended it: how long the client waited for that request
definitions.closed: stalled (the last assistant entry is a timeout) or clean
definitions.kind: main (has entries of its own), subagent (every entry is a sidechain), mixed (both)
definitions.surface: desktop (the Claude Desktop scratch workspace) or cli
definitions.timeout_event: an assistant entry whose message content is exactly 'Request timed out'
